messages.content: Enter the make.fun bounty news-image-20261118: build an entry repo, push to github.com/yogio1/news-image-20261118 and submit.

I'll build a news-summary image entry. First I read make.fun/skill.md (v1.5.204) and the competition requirements from GET /api/competitions/news-image-20261118/requirements: program/v1 harness, no network, write /output/entry.png as a whole PNG or JPEG of at most 1 MiB and 1024x1024, two runs must produce identical bytes, judged by an AI vision model comparing images two at a time. No unmet prerequisites, so I can proceed. My plan: research today's news, design a 1024x1024 infographic with Pillow, wrap it in a deterministic main.py, push to a new public repo, then submit with a signed entry message.

Researching the day's news now. From AP and TASS: a Russian An-12 military transport crashed in western Siberia killing all 19 aboard, preliminary cause a technical malfunction. From Gulf News and RFE/RL: US-Iran tit-for-tat strikes continue - the US hit Qeshm island while Bahrain and Kuwait report drone attacks; oil holds near $93 on Gulf risk. From the Manila Times and AP: at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen Xi Jinping urged free and open trade, and at the ASEAN summit in Manila Modi called for peace, stability and predictability. Reuters: oil prices fell as US crude stocks rose. Two AI-safety stories: models tricked into military targeting, and a UNESCO study on AI climate misinformation.

Writing the design script now. I'll create a dark-theme 1024x1024 canvas in Pillow 12.3.0 with DejaVu fonts, a header band reading WORLD NEWS / Wednesday, 18 November 2026, five colour-coded story panels (CONFLICT red, DISASTER red, DIPLOMACY blue, ECONOMY yellow, TECHNOLOGY blue) each with a coloured edge bar and two wrapped lines of text, and a footer band. I write the first version of entry.py that draws this layout and renders entry.png.

Reviewed the render: the header and footer are fine but two story panels overflow their boxes and the category tag sits too close to the body text. I'm revising entry.py: increase per-panel height to 24 + lines*36 + 22, move the tag to y+12 and body lines to y+42 with 36 px leading, and push the footer down. Re-render and re-check.

Second visual pass: layout is now balanced and all text sits inside its panel. One more refinement to entry.py for contrast: brighten body text to (245,245,245) and panel fill to (24,31,41). Final size is 89,402 bytes, within the 1 MiB gate, 1024x1024 pixels. Now I write main.py, the deliverable: it copies the committed entry.png byte-for-byte to /output/entry.png with shutil, so two runs produce identical bytes with no network. Adding LICENSE (MIT) and README.md.

Committed all five files as 77908fa and pushed to github.com/yogio1/news-image-20261118 via the GitHub API. The first submit was refused on entry_signature - the entry needs a wallet on the account - so after the owner allowed the Profile scope I registered the agent wallet with wallet add, updated the README with the three required make.fun badges and the repo About (website + makefun topic), pushed as cb1bc8d, and signed the entry message with the agent keypair. Submitting now.
Submitted: receipt 01a1ee61, claim code saved, bundle sha 77a1a34b. Status submitting then checking; I'll poll the API for the grader's verdict.
